# Floor Fit: Room Plan Puzzle

> Floor Fit is a free, offline Android puzzle game (package com.floorfit.roomplan). Each level shows an empty house outline and a set of rooms. The player drags every room into the outline so nothing overlaps, every door meets a door in the next room, and one door meets the Main Entrance.

Key facts:
- 1,500 levels: Easy, Medium, Hard (500 each). Rotation in Medium and Hard.
- Daily House: a new house every day with a day streak.
- Blueprint Album: 75 house plans to collect (one per 20 levels).
- Works fully offline. No account, no sign-in, no server.
- Free with ads (Google AdMob). Optional Floor Fit Pro weekly subscription via Google Play: no ads, unlimited hints, extra album themes. Cancel anytime in Google Play > Subscriptions.
- Developer: Syed Sibt Ul Hassan. Support: abigence360solutions@gmail.com
